items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You have a lovely daughter... Inez. ... [INTERVIEWEE] She is doing fine.

ctx.x: Yes, well I have to — I must preface this — the reason I’m wearing my sweatshirt today that was specially designed for me. I think this is the eighteenth party that Don and Susan have given, and each year they’ve always honored a male musician. And I’m very happy to say that I am the first non-musician and the first female to be honored at this party so I think it’s quite an honor.

You have a lovely daughter, and a granddaughter whom I know you idolize, Inez. And I’m not going to ask you how she is because that would mean that we’d use the rest of the tape listening to stories about Inez. But I hope she is well.
